policies.title: Sensitive tables are only reached by logged-in endpoints
policies.statement: Every endpoint that reaches a table carrying the invoices tag, directly or through a function, must require authentication. An endpoint that returns invoice data to an anonymous caller is a finding. Tables that must stay open are not exempt by this policy; the policy owner decides any change.

warnings.text: table_tags "invoices" is on no table in this workspace, so no access to it is judged.
